sources.finding: 18 public training recordings include JSON ROI annotations; official testing images omit ground truth. Provider prefixes group laboratories, not independently resolved animal IDs.
Publisher describes each image-stack archive as around 1GB zipped and several GB unzipped.
MIT scorer code available. Uses center-distance matching plus separate overlap/exactness measures; cannot substitute generic IoU F1 without a custom-endpoint disclaimer.

C01.reason: No data-specific reuse/redistribution terms resolved in source; no official hidden test masks. A true ROI endpoint is technically possible by holding out complete annotated training recordings, but requires an explicitly custom split, exact legacy center matcher, streaming movie summaries or adequate full-movie budget, and resolved data rights. Do not call a convenient single frame or one small archive the Neurofinder benchmark.
C01.reactivation: Resolve upstream data terms, pin archives for all recording groups, keep entire recording groups disjoint, retain original ROI coordinates including overlaps, port/verify official scorer, prerecord custom processing and split before generation.
C01.downloads: No multi-GB image stacks downloaded during this bounded audit.

C06.rights: Repository GPL-3.0; no separate data-specific license declaration located; local cache only, preserve original attribution and acquisition metadata.
C06.strongest_defensible_available_fixed_ref: OASIS default AR1 with training-only global scaling; NOT uncontaminated CASCADE/SOTA. Public global CASCADE weights include DS04 test cells.

sources.finding: Paper quantitative ground-truth recovery experiments are simulated; real recordings are evaluated by decomposition, detected components, and between-algorithm comparisons.
CC0; four real MAT movies totaling 1.88GB, striatum/PFC/hippocampus/BNST, with four README files, no independent annotation archive listed.

Pinned Git tree has data/.gitignore and results/.gitignore only; README links externally downloaded movies. No released independent manual instance masks or simultaneous electrophysiology labels located.

C09.reason: CC0 real movies are accessible, but source extraction accuracy cannot use CNMF-E outputs as independent ground truth. Simulations would be a valid separate synthetic operation but do not satisfy requested real-data endpoint. Four large movies alone do not produce train_y.
C09.reactivation: Locate independently annotated multi-recording masks or paired spike/trace truth, with explicit scoring and specimen split. Alternatively authorize an explicitly simulated/semi-synthetic endpoint with simulation-native truth and a fixed generator.
